# Build Gradio web UIs and demos in Python: components, events, chatbots, custom HTML

Curated by Skill Harbor — @huggingface's official Gradio skill for agents: a dense, copy-friendly API reference for building interactive web UIs and ML demos in Python. Covers the three core patterns — `gr.Interface` (function wrapped with input/output components), `gr.Blocks` (low-level layout with explicit event wiring), and `gr.ChatInterface` (chatbot UIs) — with full component signatures (Textbox, Number, Slider, Checkbox, Dropdown, Radio, Image, Audio, Video, File, Chatbot, Button, Markdown, HTML and more), every supported event listener per component, custom HTML components (html_template, css_template, js_on_load) with a worked StarRating example, and the `gradio` Prediction CLI (`info` and `predict`) for programmatically discovering and calling endpoints on Spaces. Points to the official gradio.app guides for deep dives. Honest caveats: a reference sheet more than a tutorial — thin on prose, heavy on signatures; the long-form guides it links to live on gradio.app and may evolve ahead of this file; built for the current Gradio API. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
